newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross says expects to post losses in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross says expects to post losses in 1997/98.

text.p: Japanese pharmaceuticals maker Green Cross Corp said on Friday that it expects to post losses in the 1997/98 business year.

Earlier, the company announced its six-month earnings which were adversely affected by a scandal, which erupted earlier this year, concerning the sale of HIV-tainted blood products by Green Cross and several other companies.
The company did not give a figure for the expected loss in 1997/98.
The company forecasts a parent current loss of 2.5 billion yen and sales of 68 billion yen for the 1996/97 business year to March 31, 1997.
Public outrage over the scandal prompted boycotts of Green Cross products at many medical institutions throughout Japan, resulting in a sharp fall in the firm's sales.
